adSupport.title: Is Alfora helping you?
adSupport.message: We could not show advertising during this visit. Alfora is free, and ads help us maintain and keep improving the tools. If you can, please allow ads for alfora.art.
adSupport.instructions: Open your ad blocker or browser protection settings and add alfora.art to the allowed-sites list. Then reload this page.
adSupport.networkNote: If ads are blocked by a university, company or managed network, you may not be able to change it from this device.
